process_notes.Florida PSC Ten-Year Site Plans (state-r: Each FL utility files an April TYSP (FPL, DEF, TECO, JEA, Seminole, OUC, Tallahassee, GRU, Lakeland, FMPA) with TLSA 230 kV+ line tables and per-plant transmission sections; PDFs at floridapsc.com/pscfiles/website-files/PDF/Utilities/Electricgas/TenYearSitePlans/2026/ and fpl.com. process_notes.BPA Attachment K Transmission Plan: BPA's annual local plan (2025 plan published Aug 2026) at bpa.gov Attachment K page, with GERP 1.0/2.0 summaries and per-area project tables (P-numbers, energization years, completed items). process_notes.Arizona ACC Ten-Year Transmission Plans: APS/SRP/TEP/UNSE/AEPCO file each Jan 31 in ACC docket E-99999A-25-0006 (14th BTA). APS 2026 plan (docket.images.azcc.gov/e000049070.pdf) has one sheet per project; nearly all already listed via WestConnect; 1 new (Goodyear 230 kV substation, in service 2025) and 3 corrections. SRP's 2026 plan PDF is not posted publicly online (used SRP board packets instead).
process_notes.WECC Annual Progress Reports (utility pl: Every WECC transmission owner files an annual progress report (Jan-Mar) listing planned BES projects with ISDs; all 2026 reports are on one WECC page. Best single sweep for the West: covered PacifiCorp, IPC, NVE, PNM, EPE, Tri-State, PSCo, Black Hills, Avista, PSE, PGE, Chelan, Grant, SCL, Tacoma, Snohomish, PRPA, CSU, WAPA, AEPCO, TEP, IID, LADWP, SMUD, SCE, PG&E, SDG&E. process_notes.NorthWestern Energy Montana IRP / LG&E-K: Checked as plan sources: NorthWestern 2026 MT IRP has only narrative (no project table); LG&E/KU 2026 preliminary TEP major-BES list has one breaker job (full list is confidential at KY PSC); Wisconsin PSC draft SEA 2026-2032 (docid 595734) discusses LRTP but has no project table. None yielded items.
process_notes.SRP board/CUP packets: SRP Customer Utility Panel and Power Committee packets (srpnet.com) give target ISDs for SRP's siting pipeline (Marigold, Coronado-Pinnacle Peak 2033, SE Valley Hub 2032, Pinal Central-East Mesa 2032); most are 2032+ or already listed; 1 correction.
process_notes.USACE ORM public data (permits.ops.usace: Public JSON search API behind the Corps 'Regulatory and Section 408 Publicly Available Data' map, covering every district: issued individual permits, pending IPs, EAs/EISs, emergency actions, AJDs and Section 408 requests with name, status and a point. Best systematic Corps source: it surfaced Overland Trail-Pony Creek, Coast-McCall, LeJeune-Riverside, Corbett-Conservation, Maybank and Emory, but most transmission work goes under NWP 57 and never appears; names rarely give kV, so each lead needs a second source.
process_notes.USACE district public notices: Each district's Public Notices page (DVIDS sites block scripts with Akamai 403; content readable through search) plus the national RRS list (only active notices, 132 at sweep time). Individual-permit notices for transmission are rare (mostly big Entergy 500 kV lines in Vicksburg/New Orleans and offshore-wind/HVDC cables); almost all were already listed.
process_notes.RRS (rrs.usace.army.mil): National Regulatory Request System public-notice list; JSON POST api/publicnotice/getPublicNotices; only currently open notices, no archive. Good for monitoring, nothing new at sweep time.
process_notes.Pennsylvania Bulletin DEP notices: Weekly DEP 'Applications, actions and special notices' with Chapter 105, 401 and NPDES construction-stormwater entries (application and 'issued' lists) naming utility line projects (PPL, PECO, FirstEnergy/MAIT) with townships, miles and permit numbers; fully crawlable HTML (vol 53-56 all swept). ~20 lines of 138 kV+ found, but nearly all map to PJM supplemental IDs already listed under generic names (s3185/s3186 PECO, s3755 Dutch Fork tap, s4020 Johnstown-Seward, s3311 Juniata-Bernheisel, b3800 Chanceford); only Ashtabula-Erie West 345 kV was new. Very useful for stage evidence (permit issued dates).
process_notes.Virginia DEQ VWP notices: DEQ calendar of VWP individual-permit public notices; only ~16 notices since late 2024 because most utility work uses general permits. Surfaced Dominion's White Oak 230 kV lines.
process_notes.FWS HCPs/ITPs (Federal Register): Only two transmission HCPs in 2023-2026 (NPPD R-Project, NEET Crossroads-Hobbs-Roadrunner); both already listed. Low yield.
process_notes.State wetland/buffer/401 notices (GA EPD: Mostly sub-138 kV maintenance or no public per-project list; Georgia buffer-variance notices name lines but those found were 115 kV or below; MiEnviro shows only current notices without project descriptions. Low yield.
process_notes.Section 106 and DOT/railroad crossing no: No systematic public lists found for transmission; searches returned only items already captured through Corps/state sources.
process_notes.FERC formula-rate annual updates/project: PJM TO postings at pjm.com/markets-and-operations/billing-settlements-and-credit/formula-rates (AEP, ATSI, PSEG, PPL, Dominion...), SPP Attachment H templates on spp.org; project detail is mostly RTEP b-numbers or plant totals, every in-scope b-number spot-checked was already listed (the unlisted ones are breakers/terminal work or pre-2023 projects) - low yield, not worth a recurring sweep.
process_notes.State rate cases / capital plans / IRPs: Duke NC MYRP, Santee Cooper rate-study GT&D report and IRP appendix, Florida Ten-Year Site Plans, Ameren MO IRP appendix; useful mainly for dates/stages (gave 3 Santee Cooper corrections), almost no unlisted lines.
process_notes.Public power and co-op boards: Board packets/minutes on each utility site (SRP CUP packets, SMUD board packets, OUC commission agendas, JEA capital-projects committee tables, Douglas PUD commission reports, Tri-State/NPPD minutes, LCRA TSC and CPS board books, Austin Legistar). Best yield in this sweep, especially Pacific Northwest PUDs/co-ops (Douglas, Chelan, Umatilla) and Florida munis (OUC, JEA) that are outside RTO lists; RTO-area boards (LCRA, CPS, NPPD, OPPD, LES, Sunflower) were almost fully listed already.
process_notes.Municipal bond official statements (EMMA: emma.msrb.org PDFs reachable directly (200 with K2 user agent) but the site has no public search API and OS capital sections are generic; the useful hit was an LES continuing-disclosure date (North Bluff 2028). Low yield.
process_notes.TVA board: Board minutes approve transmission budgets and land-rights lists by reference to memo attachments that are not posted; TVA project pages (403 to scripts) are already well covered in the list.
process_notes.Co-op project pages tied to RUS/board ap: Northeast Missouri Power, UEC, UAMPS/St. George reports surfaced small 138-230 kV lines missing from the list; some co-op lines are built to 161 kV but operated at 69 kV (Missouri-Iowa, Axtell-Lovelake) and were skipped.
process_notes.OpenStreetMap (Overpass API): Volunteer-tagged lifecycle features (power=construction, construction:power=*, proposed:power=*). overpass-api.de reset connections from here; the maps.mail.ru Overpass mirror answered 14 lower-48 bounding-box queries (some retried after 504s). Only ~40 U.S. features at 138 kV+ are tagged; every one that could be identified (Delaney-Colorado River, Jamestown-Ellendale, TVA 161 kV lines, CHPE/Astoria-Rainey, Sunrise/Empire Wind, Harpers, Dover PAR, Loudoun substations, Jerome) is already listed. Useful only as a cross-check; tagging is sparse and stale, and several features were in Mexico/Canada.
process_notes.Our Grid Future national planned-transmi: Horizon Energy Systems compilation published as a public ArcGIS FeatureServer (June 2026: 707 line segments with owner, status, kV, est. year, endpoints and a source link per row; plus substations and study concepts). Most useful map source: after automated plus manual matching, roughly 90-95% of in-window rows were already in Line Watch (often under PJM/MISO/ERCOT/TPIT IDs); the rest led, via each row's cited utility/BPA/CAISO/ATC source, to the new items here. Rows cited only to misoenergy.org (MTEP) could not be confirmed and were left out.
process_notes.Other ArcGIS Online / Hub layers: Searched www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/search with ~25 queries (about 420 distinct public items screened, many student/foreign/irrelevant). Utility and consultant project layers (TEP, AES Ohio, Xcel, Santee Cooper, PacifiCorp/Stantec, ATC, TVA, Basin, AEP Texas, SPS, FirstEnergy Survey123) were queried through their REST endpoints. Most map projects already listed; new ones were TEP Southeast Energy Link and FirstEnergy Elko-Moshannon. Three Peaks-Purgatory Flat 345 kV is real but due 2033 (outside the window). Many layers are Survey123 forms or parcel layers with no attributes.
process_notes.TVA TSSProjects_Hosted: TVA's public siting register (447 proposed-centerline features). Projects that are not already listed trace to 2014-2019 TVA environmental assessments with in-service dates of 2016-2020, so they fall outside the window, and TVA's site is behind a Cloudflare challenge. Low yield.
process_notes.HIFLD / EIA open data: The HIFLD/Esri U.S. Electric Power Transmission Lines layer has only 25 'UNDER CONSTRUCTION' features, all 2014-2021 vintage (AEP Ohio 69/138 kV, Red Butte-Sigurd, Selmer-West Adamsville), with no proposed status. It is stale and yielded nothing new. EIA publishes no open planned-transmission dataset (EIA-411 is not public line-level data). Not useful.
process_notes.State PUC / siting-board GIS route layer: Found as embedded layers rather than catalogs: Virginia Energy planned-lines layer (an Our Grid Future subset), Wisconsin PSC experience-builder maps, Morrow County OR planning layer, Jefferson County WV Valley Link layer. All projects they show are already listed.
process_notes.CAISO transmission plan status tables (f: Tables 8-1 to 8-3 of the CAISO 2025-2026 plan list current expected in-service dates for every previously approved project. This gave 3 new upgrades and 3 date corrections. It is a good cross-check source for date changes.
process_notes.Contractor press releases and project po: Company news pages and 'projects' portfolios (e.g., myrgroup.com/projects, burnsmcd.com/projects, kiewit.com/projects, michels.us/experience/projects, mortenson.com/projects). Most portfolio entries were older than 2023-11, 115-138 kV, unnamed/'confidential', or already listed; earnings-call award mentions (MYR) rarely name the line. Moderate value as a pointer: led to Carlson Creek 345 kV switchyard, Seaside and Sundial 230 kV BESS substations, Chase City-Cloud (listed) and from there Dominion's Clover-Chase City rebuild.
process_notes.Engineering News-Record (ENR) and T&D Wo: ENR keyword list (enr.com/articles/keyword/725-transmission-line) and regional Best Projects; T&D World section RSS feeds. Good for energization/construction-start confirmations; most named items were already listed, but surfaced BPA Midway-Ashe 230 kV, ComEd's two 345 kV wind substations, the ISA 345 kV application and Carlson Creek.
process_notes.Utility / public-power bid notices and p: City bid boards (Lodi), Grant PUD forecasted-needs PDF and Procureware notices, NPPD bids (nebraskabids mirror), OPPD project page, PGE RFPs. Small but high-precision: Guild 230/60 kV (Lodi), Monument Hill 230 kV switchyard and dated QTEP schedules (Grant PUD); PGE's Warm Springs Power Pathway RFP is out of window (COD 2032).
process_notes.Equipment supplier orders (Hitachi Energ: Supplier press rooms. Orders are almost all for already-listed megaprojects (SunZia, Grain Belt, SOO Green, CHPE, North Plains Connector, Minnesota Power HVDC, Texas 765 kV); several new HVDC links found (Southern Spirit, Commonwealth Energy Express, Warm Springs) are due 2032+ and were excluded. Low yield for new items.
process_notes.IBEW locals and project labor agreements: IBEW 1245 quarterly Outside Line reports (ibew1245.com/feed). Names contractors and job starts (Wilson on SWIP-North, T&D Power on Greenlink); pointed to NV Energy's 2026 IRP transmission action plan, which yielded 8 unlisted NV projects and 5 date corrections. A union report alone is not used as a source.
process_notes.Spill-over utility sources reached from: BPA GERP status (Aug 2026 GAT workshop, 2025 Transmission Plan), NV Energy 2026 IRP Vol. 2 action plan, Dominion power line project index, PGE/OPUC filings, MISO EPR (Murphy-Orr Road, via Grid Strategies/FERC infrastructure update). These produced most of the new items.
process_notes.NERC LTRA and seasonal assessments: Annual/seasonal reliability reports at nerc.com (Reliability Assessments). They report transmission only as mileage totals and a few marquee projects (B2H, Blueprint, CHPE, Energy Gateway) that Line Watch already has; essentially zero new items.
process_notes.Regional entity assessments (SERC, NPCC: Annual long-term assessments on each regional entity site; mostly aggregate miles; the NPCC LRAO names NY/NE projects (CHPE, Smart Path, BCEH, Eastern Queens, Propel) all already listed or below the size threshold. Low value.
process_notes.WECC Annual Progress Reports: Per-utility APRs and a yearly summary/waiver list on the WECC Progress Reports page (8 pages of PDFs). Line Watch evidently already mined these (LADWP, SCE, APS items all present); yielded Feedville (Blueprint East). Medium value as a monitor source since new APRs post each Feb-Mar.
process_notes.WestTEC 10-year study: Western Power Pool PDF; its reference-case tables list ~110 planned western upgrades with sponsors. About 85% were already listed; remainder were post-2031 (Blueprint South/North, Big Eddy-Chemawa, Warm Springs Pathway, Three Peaks-Purgatory Flat, PSE Cross-Cascades) or cancelled (Del Amo-Mesa-Serrano); yielded Bolo and Ross-Rivergate. Its own 'solutions' (Townsend-Midpoint etc.) are conceptual and were not listed.
process_notes.CTPC Collaborative Transmission Plan: carolinastpc.org reference documents (annual plan in April, mid-year update in August). All 230/500 kV items were already listed; useful for status changes (2 corrections). Medium value for corrections.
process_notes.Colorado Rule 3627 10-year plan / CETA: Combined Colorado plan filed every Feb (hosted on tristate.coop and in CO PUC 26M-0051E). Nearly all 230/345 kV items listed; found Cross Point 230/69 kV. CETA's shortlist is conceptual (no dates).
process_notes.New Mexico RETA: nmreta.com project list and legislative annual reports. All in-window projects already listed (Mora, Hidden Mountain, RioSol, CHR built); North Path is 2032; Eastern NM Connector has no date or application (not listed).
process_notes.Montana / Wyoming / Nevada state studies: Montana connectivity study is conceptual; Wyoming Intertie already listed; North Plains Connector in service end-2032 (outside window); Greenlink already listed. Low value.
process_notes.BPA GERP: bpa.gov GERP page with project summaries and dated ISDs. Most items listed or post-2031; added Ross-Rivergate 230 kV (2031).
process_notes.NY CGPP / Con Edison LTP: NY PSC Case 20-E-0197 Cycle 1 report (May 2026) proposes NYSEG Binghamton 230-to-345 kV and Southern Tier 345 kV expansions and National Grid 115 kV upgrades, but none is approved and in-service years in the modeling are 2035+; Eastern Queens is a 138 kV substation (below threshold). Nothing added.
process_notes.ISO-NE LTTP / Maine NMRED: ISO-NE selected CMP/Eversource LTP A1 (Pittsfield - Coopers Mills and Buxton - Deerfield 345 kV etc.) in Aug 2026 but in-service is Q4 2032; Maine's Pittsfield - Haynesville line is 2033. Both outside the 2031-11 window, so not listed.
process_notes.DOE Needs Study / NIETC: DOE cancelled all three Phase 3 NIETC corridors on Aug 12, 2026; corridors named Heartland Spirit, Southline Ph 3, TRIBES but no new dated projects. No value.
process_notes.NJ BPU SAA: BPU docket QO20100630 and PJM TEAC. The SAA was terminated (BPU Apr 22, 2026; FERC accepted June 22, 2026): 42 projects cancelled, only b3737.1/.38/.39/.45/.47/.60 remain. High value for corrections (4 listed NJCEC items now cancelled).
process_notes.Maryland POWER Act SAA: PSC Case 9800 / PJM TEAC; only injection scenarios (Indian River, Cool Spring, Piney Grove, Nelson, Calvert Cliffs), no solution selected yet. Nothing to list.
process_notes.BOEM COPs and state siting for offshore: BOEM state-activities pages hold each COP/FEIS/ROD with onshore routes and POIs. Highest-yield source here: SouthCoast Wind (Brayton Point), New England Wind 1 and 2 (West Barnstable), Vineyard Northeast CT (Montville), CVOW onshore export cables. Skipped: Atlantic Shores (OREC vacated, ISA cancelled), Ocean Wind/Empire Wind 2/NY5 (cancelled or no award), CVOW-South/Kitty Hawk (mid-2030s), Humboldt (2034), Morro Bay (no approved transmission), Gulf of Maine (no onshore project).
process_notes.Offshore wind status trackers: New Bedford Light tracker, NYSERDA pages, Dominion 10-Q/SCC reports: used for status corrections (CVOW Harpers/Fentress built Mar 2026; Sunrise and Empire Wind COD 2027).
